documents.content:
Visa Requirements for International Travel

All applicants travelling on an international itinerary must hold a passport that remains valid for at least six months beyond the intended date of return. A passport valid for fewer than six months will not be accepted at check-in.

Applicants must submit a completed Form GT-4412 together with two passport photographs. Photographs must be taken within the previous six months and must show a plain white background.
documents.title: Visa Requirements

documents.content:
Visa Processing Times (Withdrawn Notice)

This notice has been withdrawn. It formerly stated that applications are processed within fifteen working days of receipt, and that an expedited service reduces processing to five working days for an additional fee of 85 USD.
documents.title: Visa Processing Times (Withdrawn)

documents.content:
Visa Processing Times (Current Notice)

This notice replaces the withdrawn processing notice. Applications are processed within twenty five working days of receipt.

An expedited service is available and reduces processing to five working days. The expedited fee is 120 USD.

The passport validity requirement is unchanged.
documents.title: Visa Processing Times (Current)

documents.content:
Travel Insurance Policy

Travel insurance is mandatory for all international trips exceeding fourteen days in duration. Trips of fourteen days or fewer do not require insurance coverage.

The policy covers medical expenses up to 250000 USD, emergency evacuation up to 100000 USD, and trip cancellation up to 5000 USD.

Claims must be submitted within ninety days of the insured event. Late claims are refused without exception.
documents.title: Travel Insurance Policy

documents.content:
Insurance Office Bulletin: Clarification of Cover

Following enquiries, the Insurance Office clarifies that the medical expense limit under the travel insurance policy is 200000 USD, not 250000 USD as stated in older guidance. All policies issued from the current academic year carry the 200000 USD limit.

This clarification applies to medical expenses only. Emergency evacuation cover remains unchanged at 100000 USD.
documents.title: Insurance Office Bulletin

documents.content:
Student Accommodation Guidance

On-campus accommodation is allocated on a first come, first served basis. Applications open on 1 April each year and close on 30 June.

Each residence room includes a desk, a single bed, and a shared kitchen. Rooms are allocated in blocks of ten students to a shared kitchen facility.

Requests for a specific residence block may be made in the application but cannot be guaranteed.
documents.title: Accommodation Guidance

documents.content:
Library Services

The library issues up to twelve borrowable items to a taught student at any one time. Research students may borrow up to twenty items.

The standard loan period is twenty one days. Items may be renewed twice unless another reader has requested them.

The library is silent and opening hours during term are 08:00 to 23:00 on weekdays and 10:00 to 18:00 at weekends.
documents.title: Library Services

documents.content:
Course Registration

Students register for courses during a two week window that opens two weeks before the start of each semester.

A standard full-time load is four courses per semester. Students may register for a maximum of five courses with the written approval of their academic adviser.

Changing a course after the second week of teaching requires a completed amendment form GT-4412.
documents.title: Course Registration
